analysis.title: GS Futures Global Equity CTA - Market Update - October 26, 2026
key_insights: Trend-follower (CTA) forecasts after Friday's close show sales of equities across all regions this week totaling around $23.5bn, roughly -1 standard deviation in size.
CTAs are estimated long about $50bn of global equities, of which $36bn (72%) is SPX.
Base case is $11.5bn of SPX selling this week while the short-term trend signal stays negative.
Both short- and medium-term trend signals are within +/-1.2% of their threshold levels, so a modest move changes the flow forecast.
If markets fall this week and the medium-term trend flips negative, SPX selling could grow to around $26bn in the worst case.
If SPX retraces part of last week's losses and the short-term signal flips positive, CTAs would still be expected to sell around $6bn of SPX.
The prior Friday note had forecast small net flows because regional buying and selling offset each other; the post-Friday-close forecasts now show selling in every region.
risk_factors: A further SPX decline this week that flips the medium-term trend signal negative would raise forecast CTA SPX selling to about $26bn.
